scope: expansion-0191 through expansion-0195, 80 page illustrations plus 5 covers

visualReview.coverage: Read all five final manuscripts, all 16 page scenes, character specifications and editorial-005-older.md before drawing. Viewed every first-draft and revised frame in five contact sheets. Enlarged 0191 p02/p09/p11/p12/p15/p16; 0192 p03/p04/p08/p09/p11/p13/p16; 0193 p02/p03/p04/p05/p06/p07/p08/p10/p11/p12/p14/p16; 0194 p03/p06/p11/p12/p13/p15; 0195 cover/p05/p06/p08/p12/p14/p16. Viewed all five final contact sheets and re-enlarged the changed mast, payment, sleeve, embroidery, cover and seated giant details. After the final 0193 surface-placement changes, viewed its whole contact sheet and the altered display/bowl/bench details again.
corrections: 0191: increased embroidery contrast; connected equal-size blank/lined test extensions to the sail; fitted the night draft inside its sheet; joined the book to both delivery hands; added visible mast/yard supports in the reduced-load and delivery scenes. Active fish retain fins/eyes while resting fish are pale watermarks. Gray patch, narrow border failure, recovered thread card, sparse retained stars and restored book load remain separate stages.

0192: joined stair treads with a beam; moved the beast away from the small doors; joined ground stairs to the body by the soft leaf band; moved the pencil into the held note and hand toward the worn stair; removed duplicate bag. Rebuilt the low seven-step moss exploration and extended windowsill exploration so stairs, door and destination connect. Four legs, round ears, long nose, seven-step reset and later handle remain consistent.

0193: added raincoat sleeves over the outstretched paper arms; kept 12 purchase coins separate from the 2 fare coins; placed payment, bowl and timetable on supported surfaces; added hang lines for the coat and sample crane; lowered the paper boat/flower onto the bench. Final actual crane carries the teal fold pattern, purple wrist ribbon and bag; there is no duplicate human or worn raincoat in flight.

0194: turned the father toward the child and put the cup at his hand; extended the drawer to the hand; connected the visible sleeping hand to a green sleeve; added the sewing worktable and thread to the new pillow flower; removed an extra embracing arm stroke. Dream corner marks distinguish imagined desert scenes, hook stays empty until the mother returns, four corner tassels and silver button eyes persist.

0195: kept the partly lifted flower roots visibly connected to the original shoe soil; grounded the empty shoe behind the new bed; moved the transplanted bed to ground level; exposed the cleaning bowl; reduced and repositioned the cover giant to fit the crop. Final giant sits with both shoes on; the new purple flower is outside the shoe. Bare borrowed foot, failed flat board, five depressions, travel bundle, root divisions, wilted plants and old crack are retained.
visualReview.limits: Simplified original vector picture-book illustrations using representative moments and frontal props. Review covers story continuity, visible anatomy, relevant props and overlaps. It does not certify bitmap painting, audio quality, browser layout, deployment or child-user testing.
